spans.s: jighatsita, adj. (ppp. of jighatsati, desid. to ghas-; Skt. jighatsu, BR 〔5.1444〕; = Pali jighacchita), hungry: Mvy 〔6306〕 (see s.v. pūrṇagātra); 〔7328〕 (v.l. and Mironov jighāṃsita, see next; precedes pipāsitaḥ); ˚tā bhojana mārgamānā(ḥ) SP 〔84.12〕 (vs); ˚tānāṃ ca sattvānām agraṃ varabhojanaṃ dadāti Śikṣ 〔274.7〕 (prose). See next.

? jighāṃsita (should be ppp. of desid. of han-! but in mg. = jighatsita!), clearly means hungry in Karmav 〔46.9〕 ˚ta-pipāsitasya kruddhasya kālakriyā; so Tib. bkres śiṅ skom pa, hungry and thirsty; and so Lévi translates, without any note, tho a note is surely needed! So v.l. for Mvy 〔7328〕, see prec. It seems likely that the true reading is jighatsita; or dare we assume that MIndic (Pali) jighacchita was falsely Sktized as jighāṃsita ?
